verdict.rationale: First-party marketing says FreshBooks lets you 'link your bank account and create automated workflows for bank reconciliation and transaction management', and separately mentions tracking expenses in real time. That covers bank linking and implies automatic import. The evidence never mentions connecting credit-card accounts or states an automatic daily import cadence, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit credit-card account connection, documented automatic daily transaction import/sync frequency, in-depth bank-feed docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
